# Theory: If You Cannot See Ref Movement, You Cannot Audit

Operational metrics (latency, error rate, disk) keep the forge up. Audit logs keep it honest. They are different streams.

## Invariants

1. Golden signals for a git frontend: fetch/push latency, 5xx, queue depth.
2. Audit: who moved which ref, who changed access.
3. SOC 2 / ISO / GDPR ask for *retention and access* of those logs.

```text
metrics  (SRE)     logs  (debug)     audit  (compliance)
all three, different retention
```

## What can break

- DEBUG application logs as your only audit trail.

## How to read this chapter

Metrics, logs, audit, tracing, frameworks, detection.
